thread:
alex: Quick sync request — CinderAI reached out asking if Redwood can host and redistribute their quantized model weights on our marketplace and allow Dedicated/Private customers to run against those weights. They also asked about dual-licensing and attribution banner. Meeting 10:00 tomorrow. cc @liz (legal) @maya (eng)

liz (legal): Need to see the actual license and any addenda. Redistribution vs hosting for inference are different rights. If license prohibits rehosting we can't publish. Also check tokenizer and third-party data attributions. Send me the license link and model card.

maya: From infra POV we can host quantized blobs and serve them from our hosted layer. For Private we should avoid copying weights into customer VPCs unless the provider explicitly allows that — prefer serving as a managed endpoint or offering a signed, time-limited pull for on-prem installs. We also need manifest + checksums + provenance tags.

tony: Marketplace notes — we prefer to surface a "verified model bundle" (weights + manifest + model card). Need SLA from provider for updates and bugfixes. Also: what does "redistribute" mean for us vs the customer? If customers can download raw weights that's different than calling a hosted endpoint.

sam_legal: I'll draft language. Key items: explicit permission to host and to redistribute derived/quantized weights; permission to allow inference in multi-tenant and single-tenant deployments; export compliance warranty (ECCN or classification), sanctions/embargo representation; limited indemnity. Also flag any license terms that restrict commercial use.

alex: Can you put a short redline before the meeting? They're expecting an answer about whether we can list them on our hosted marketplace.

liz (legal): I'll draft a narrow addendum: grant to "host, distribute, and provide inference services on derived/quantized artifacts" with usage restrictions if any. Also need contact for export paperwork.

maya: Operational checklist I'll fill: quantization artifacts (int8, int4) verified, accuracy regression <1% vs baseline, KV cache compatibility, input tokenization parity, checksum & provenance, storage + egress cost estimate. Will attach sample benchmark numbers after tests.

tony: Marketing + comms: if we list them we want a joint announcement plan. Request: 72-hour embargo window for copy sign-off and logo usage. Also need to confirm whether provider requires attribution text on the model UI.

alex: I just DM'd the CinderAI rep with license link and model_card v1.0. If they send a CSV of dependencies and any restricted datasets callouts, forward to Liz.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Calendar invite "CinderAI distribution sync" at 10:00 tomorrow has been added and includes draft agenda.

sam_legal: One more — confirm whether provider permits redistribution of quantized derivatives to resellers or partners. If yes, we should cap liability and set revocation terms.

maya: FYI: if we host quantized weights we should store original FP32 source as well for rebuilds and legal audit (encrypted at rest, separate KMS). That will add ~3x storage.

alex: Perfect. Action items: Liz drafts addendum, Sam drafts clause for resellers, Maya prepares ops checklist and rough cost, Tony prepares comms timeline. We'll sync in the 10:00 meeting. :thumbsup:

liz (legal): Got it. I'll aim to post a draft in this thread 1hr before the meeting.
